full_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Project owl pet concept plate #108 Otus rutilus v10.
Image1 is exact edit target v9. Image2 is Frank Vassen's actual Andasibe juvenile photograph, biological reference only, never paste it.
Change ONLY juvenile belly/chest surface pattern and tiny header version v9 to v10. Remove the conspicuous broad dark horizontal rings on the juvenile. Match photo's low-contrast irregular fine brown mottling: many tiny diffuse broken flecks, no continuous stripes wrapping body. Dense short avian down with fine straight tips; avoid loops, yarn, curly wool, shaggy fur. Keep natural subtle uneven tonal shading, not blank plastic.
Preserve both adults exactly: same brown morph, yellow eyes, gray-brown bill/cere, fine black shafts and herringbone markings, black-edged whitish scapular stripe, feathered tarsi ending at bare gray-brown toes with dark claws, adult male/female near-equal displayed height. Do not infer height from female average18g greater mass.
Preserve juvenile dark mask, pink lower lid, yellow-brown iris, dark bill, head shape, concealed folded wings, hidden tail, no ear tufts, and its two feet gripping solid branch. All three birds stable on same mossy humidforest branch. No flight, no nest, no mature wing feathers. Preserve entire composition/lighting/style/background and label positions. Preserve AGE UNKNOWN, FLIGHT UNVERIFIED, SCIENCE PENDING notices. This remains a stylized concept, not scientific approval.
review: Actual full image viewed against v9 and Vassen field photo. Broad repetitive dark belly rings visibly removed; surface now fine irregular brown shading. Adult IDs/yellow eyes/scapular white-black marks/gray-brown bare toes/dark claws retained, male/female near equal height. Juvenile dark mask/pink lower lid/closed concealed wings/no tufts, both feet grip continuous branch; no nest/mature flight pose. However numerous small looping hairlike filaments persist and exceed photo's short granular feather texture; this defect remains NEEDS_REVISION. The bounded tonal edit worked but did not solve material identity, so no scientific pass or completed-species increment. Header v10 correct. Lesson: target color-pattern separately from fiber geometry, don't claim successful biological calibration when only stripe contrast fixed.
